paper_title: Prometheus 2 An Open Source Language Model Specialized in Evaluating   Other Language Models
caption: When merging models, the influence of relative evaluation on absolute evaluation is greater than the influence of absolute evaluation on relative evaluation. Performance of Direct Assessment (colored in green) and Pairwise Ranking (colored in blue) when altering the value to merge evaluator LMs trained on different formats.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the Direct Assessment Correlation and Pairwise Ranking Accuracy as the Direct Assessment : Pairwise Ranking Merging Ratio changes. The x-axis, labeled “Direct Assessment : Pairwise Ranking Merging Ratio,” uses a linear scale ranging from 1:9 to 9:1, with tick intervals of 1 and values displayed in increments of 1. The y-axis, labeled “Direct Assessment Pearson Correlation” and “Pairwise Ranking Accuracy”, utilizes a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.500 to 0.675, with tick intervals of 0.010. The first line, colored green, represents Direct Assessment Correlation and appears to start at approximately 0.575 and gradually decreases to approximately 0.525 by the end of the x-axis. A second line, colored blue, represents Pairwise Ranking Accuracy and begins at approximately 0.630, decreases to approximately 0.600 around the 4:6 mark, and then rises to approximately 0.675 at the end of the x-axis. A third line, colored black, represents Average Performance, which begins at approximately 70 and declines to approximately 63 by the end of the x-axis.
